blocks.text: PRÉSENCE(S) PHOTOGRAPHIE aims to bring vibrant, high-quality artistic photography to everyone. It organises a festival in the middle Rhône valley, on both banks of the river around Montélimar, Le Teil and Viviers.
The 2027 festival will take place from Saturday 29 May to Sunday 13 June.

During the festival, several screening sessions are scheduled on a big screen. This is an opportunity for photographic artists to present their work to an audience of enthusiasts and professionals alike. It is a chance to engage and share ideas with leading figures in the world of photography.

At each screening, members of the audience are invited to vote for two slideshows. The winner will have their series exhibited during the 2028 festival, with production handled by Présence(s) Photographie.

You can take part, regardless of your status, age or nationality, with the exception of members of the Board of Directors of Présence(s) Photographie. There is just one requirement: the photographic work must be your own. You may submit a maximum of two projects, but only one of them may be selected.
